releaseStatus: Experimental alpha.53. Hidden native two-client same-PC tests measured 0.07 m on-foot spacing p95 with no added delay, and 0.364/0.355 m at a simulated 300 ms RTT. Guest driving and passenger checks passed for two cars, a bike, and a helicopter; this does not verify every vehicle. Public internet/NAT routes, boats, planes, complete gameplay synchronization, and fresh-Windows first-run remain unverified. Each player imports their own legally obtained Vice City files; no original game assets are included.
